CITIZENS’ ADVISORY COMMISSION ON DISABILITIES AGENDA
  THURSDAY, APRIL 9, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 1:00 PM
Gretchen Swanson, Chair  Ashley Jones, Member
Chaka Garbutt, Vice Chair  Randy Hope, Member
Julie Dean, Secretary  Arthur Romo, Member
Stephen Adams, Member  Kim Vuong, Member
Marissa Gonzalez, Member

  Citizens' Advisory Commission on Disabilities In-Person Meeting

  Members of the public have the option to submit online and email public comments
  to ada@longbeach.gov

  Comments may also be provided in the Zoom meeting using the raise hand function or by
  pressing *9 on your phone

  Please dial: (213) 338-8477 / Meeting ID: 930 3112 3898
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/93031123898

 Please note the Zoom meeting may encounter technical disruptions, but in-person access and
  public comment will continue to be available in accordance with the Brown Act

  To view the meeting from your computer, tablet, or smartphone
  visit: https://longbeach.primegov.com/public/portal?fromiframe=true

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54835  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Citizens’ Advisory Commission on
  Disabilities meeting of Thursday, March 12, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54836  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the City Manager’s Office
  on implementation of California Senate Bill 707 (SB 707).

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54837  Recommendation to receive and file a report from Dr. Gary Hytrek and Wesley
  Rogers of California State University, Long Beach, regarding the Disability Data &
  Community Survey.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 2
   CITIZENS’ ADVISORY COMMISSION ON DISABILITIES AGENDA
  THURSDAY, APRIL 9, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 1:00 PM

4.  26-54838  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Citizens' Advisory Commission on Disabilities on non-agenda items. Each
speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, please contact ada@longbeach.gov.
